segments.title: 第95章 真實的差距
segments.content:
Reigniting the Verdant Years Chapter 95: The True Gap

On the 4th and 5th, Li Luo and the other two spent two days completing several practice tests.

It had to be said, the ability of the memory palace was truly powerful.

For a purely linguistic subject like English, Li Luo, having mastered the memory palace, was operating on a whole other level.

Excluding the essay, which he didn't write, he only lost one point on the entire paper.

As for Chinese, because it had things like reading comprehension, even though there were problem-solving patterns and techniques, it ultimately wasn't something that could be completely mastered just by relying on the memory palace.

After checking the answers, besides the essay, he lost another five or six points in Chinese.

Math was even more惨烈, he lost a total of eight points.

And this was only because the first-year high school knowledge points had just begun. Li Luo managed to solve most of the problems just by relying on the formulas and example questions stored in his memory palace.

The slightly harder problems didn't pose too much of an issue either, thanks to his diligent studying during this period.

It was always the last question of the multiple-choice, fill-in-the-blank, and free-response sections that would stump him.

This kind of thing couldn't be solved simply by relying on the memory palace; it tested the comprehensive application and mastery of knowledge points.

This was where Li Luo mainly lost points.

As for subjects like physics and chemistry, since they had only just been separated from the middle school subject of "science" in the first year of high school, the content was very simple. At most, Li Luo would lose a point or two due to carelessness.

Liberal arts subjects like history, geography, and politics were even more of a breeze for Li Luo.

If Li Luo's use of the memory palace during the high school entrance exams was still slightly clumsy,

then now, it could truly be said to be completely smooth.

"Not bad, Li Luo." After calculating Li Luo's score, Xu Youyu revealed a somewhat amazed expression. "Didn't you score so little on the exam at the start of the semester? I didn't expect you to improve so quickly."

"What do you mean 'so little'? I still got 316 points! The full score is only 360."

"But I scored 1038 points, and the full score for nine subjects is 1050," Xu Youyu said with a blink. "What was Xixi's score again?"

"357," Ying Chanxi said casually. "I lost two points on the Chinese essay and one point on reading comprehension."

"Darn it." Xu Youyu sighed. "Looking at it this way, I lost quite a few points."

Damn it all...

The corner of Li Luo's mouth twitched. He thought to himself that these two were not human.

Were those scores that a human could achieve?

Never mind Ying Chanxi; she got full marks in both math and English.

Xu Youyu took nine subjects for her second-year start-of-semester exam—Chinese, math, English, physics, chemistry, biology, politics, history, and geography—and she scored 1038?

She only lost 12 points in total.

Spread across each subject, that wasn't even 2 points per subject.

Li Luo had been quite pleased with his score of 944 in this exam competition, but he was immediately put down.

Now, looking at the practice tests Ying Chanxi and Xu Youyu had done over the past two days, their calculated scores were basically all above 960.

Ying Chanxi had 964, and Xu Youyu had 962.

Excluding the 60 points for the Chinese essay and 25 points for the English essay, the total possible score was only 965...

"But you're already very impressive," Xu Youyu said, glancing at Li Luo's score again with admiration. "Anyway, getting into the top one hundred of the whole school is definitely not a problem. You're probably at a mid-level in Class Two."

"It's best not to praise him too much," Ying Chanxi said from the side. "The tests we did these two days were all targeted at the very beginning of the first-year high school curriculum, so they were definitely the least difficult."

"High school content gets harder and harder the further you go. Li Luo, don't get too proud. You need to maintain a level head and not slack off."

"You should at least wait until the second or third year of high school, when you've pretty much learned all the content, before looking at your scores and rankings. Only then can they be considered relatively stable."

With the two of you here, how could I possibly get proud... Li Luo complained in his head.

But he soon thought of a question and asked curiously, "You guys in the key class started studying during the summer break. What stage are you at now?"

"We've finished all the first-year content. After the semester started, it's all been second-year content," Ying Chanxi said honestly. "But I learned a lot in middle school already. I can probably finish the third-year content this semester, and after that, I'll be preparing for the math competition with Teacher Sun."

Li Luo: "..."

He originally thought the gap between him and Ying Chanxi was just the difference between 944 and 964 points.

But that 20-point gap was only because the test paper was relatively simple.

This was Li Luo's ceiling, but it was just Ying Chanxi's and Xu Youyu's floor.

For academic prodigies like them, the higher the difficulty of the test, the more advantageous it was, as it allowed them to widen the score gap with others.

Fortunately, Li Luo never intended to crush them from the start. He just wanted to see the gap between himself and the top student in the grade.

Currently, although the gap was still not small, at least it wasn't too far off.

With the memory palace in hand, he could at least completely make up for any lack in academic talent.

What's more, Li Luo never had any intention of fighting for first place.

Being able to maintain a ranking in the top one hundred of his grade at Fuzhong No. 1 High School was enough for him.

"You should stop discouraging him." Seeing Li Luo's expression and reaction, Xu Youyu chuckled from the side. "Anyway, the results of this test are good. Junior, just keep up the good work. Strive to surpass Xixi and take first place in future exams!"

"Although your words are a bit passive-aggressive, I'll still thank you for your encouragement," Li Luo said with a forced chuckle.

After calculating the scores, Li Luo took out his several test papers and found the questions he got wrong.

Ying Chanxi and Xu Youyu sat on either side of him and began to tutor him on his mistakes.

Although both were proud top students of the grade, their learning methods and problem-solving approaches were quite different.

Ying Chanxi pursued perfection, thinking through every step in great detail.

Xu Youyu's thought process, however, was much more unrestrained, always inexplicably skipping several steps.

This was very obvious in some math problems.

Li Luo's thinking couldn't keep up with the jumpy Xu Youyu, so he chose to listen more to Ying Chanxi.

But when it came to Chinese reading comprehension, Xu Youyu's thought process was smoother, whereas Ying Chanxi's way of thinking required more effort.

So when looking at Chinese reading comprehension, Li Luo mainly listened to how Xu Youyu thought.

By drawing on each other's strengths to make up for his weaknesses, he was making rapid progress.

When evening came, their study session ended, and Ying Chanxi and Xu Youyu went out together to buy groceries.

Li Luo, on the other hand, stayed home, responsible for tidying up the desk, cleaning, and then preparing to cook in a while.

Just then, his phone rang.

He picked it up and saw that it was a call from Yan Zhusheng.

"Hello?"

"The theme song has been decided," Yan Zhusheng said from the other end of the line. "It's your 'Annual Rings'. Auntie Luo Fei's side has already given me the contract. When do you want it?"

Li Luo raised his eyebrows, not expecting them to be so efficient. "Are you free tomorrow?"

"Yes," Yan Zhusheng nodded. "Should I come find you?"

"Uh..." Li Luo had wanted to say he would go to her, but he didn't expect Yan Zhusheng to be so proactive. "You can come find me. Xixi and Senior are both here. You can bring your homework and stuff and stay here for a day."

"Okay," Yan Zhusheng nodded, clearly quite satisfied with this arrangement. "Then I'll come over tomorrow morning."

After hanging up, Li Luo was also in a great mood.

It wasn't because Yan Zhusheng was coming over to hang out, but because the song "Annual Rings" could be sold.

According to what Yan Zhusheng had said last time, the price for a theme song was at least around fifty thousand.

If the collaboration went well this time, Li Luo's little private fund would become much more substantial.

When Yan Zhusheng came tomorrow, Li Luo planned to ask her again about the song "Waiting for You After Class," to see if her mother's company was interested.

Holding onto that thing was like a hot potato.

The plot in "I'm Really Not a Star" didn't have a use for this song yet.

At that time, Li Luo had simply been caught up in the moment and sang the song casually in front of Ying Chanxi, not thinking at all about the aftermath.

If it kept sitting in his hands until Jay Chou wrote the song, that would be truly awkward.

Just as Li Luo was thinking about these things, Ying Chanxi and Xu Youyu returned from grocery shopping.

The three of them bustled in the kitchen for over an hour, making a few small dishes.

During dinner, Ying Chanxi said, "Xinyan said she wanted to hang out with me. I figured since I have to help you study hard these few days, I just told her to come directly to our place."

"Now?" Li Luo asked, puzzled.

"Of course not." Ying Chanxi shot him a look. "I told her to come tomorrow morning and study with us for the day."

"Oh, I see," Li Luo nodded, then also said, "Yan Zhusheng is coming over tomorrow too, just letting you know."

"Huh?" Ying Chanxi was taken aback. "What's she coming for?"

"To study together, of course."

Li Luo couldn't very well say that he sold a song, could he?

If Ying Chanxi and Xu Youyu found out about that song "Annual Rings" and followed the trail back to the fact that he was writing a book, that would be truly unbearable.

After placating Ying Chanxi and Xu Youyu, Li Luo finished his meal, went back to his bedroom, and began his grand undertaking of writing.

But halfway through, Li Luo suddenly realized that tomorrow, with Ying Chanxi, Xu Youyu, plus Yan Zhusheng and Qiao Xinyan, they would all be girls, and he would be the only guy.

The thought was a little uncomfortable.

So Li Luo stopped his hands on the keyboard, took out his phone, and scrolled through his contacts.

Then he made a call.

"Yo? What's up? Wanna play ball?"

"Hey, Xiao Jun, want to come hang out at my place tomorrow?"

(End of Chapter)
